newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brite Voice cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brite Voice cut.

text.p: -- First Albany Corp said it cut Brite Voice Systems Inc to buy from strong buy.
-- said it cut the 1997 earnings estimate to $0.81 a share from $1.13 a share.
-- cited slowdown in service revenues for rating, estimate cut.
-- said Brite Voice's fourth quarter results were better than expected, but underlying issues surrounding the company's service business continue to affect profitability.
-- Brite Voice lost 1 to 13 in morning trading.
